proof_body:
by
  intro f a b hab hf
  have hne : (Set.Icc a b).Nonempty := Set.nonempty_Icc.mpr hab
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxm⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMinOn hne hf
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hym⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn hne hf
  exact ⟨x, hx, y, hy, fun t ht => ⟨isMinOn_iff.mp hxm t ht, isMaxOn_iff.mp hym t ht⟩⟩
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), a ≤ b → ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b) → ∃ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∃ y ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, f x ≤ f t ∧ f t ≤ f y
